models.title: Choose Your Partnership Model
models.lede: IDGen can work with different partner types depending on the business relationship.

reseller.title: 1. IDGen Reseller Partner
reseller.tag: Sell Identification Products in Your Market
reseller.desc: As a reseller, you acquire customers and sell IDGen products under an agreed reseller arrangement.
reseller.note: You can develop your own customer relationships while using IDGen as your production partner.

referral.title: 2. Referral Partner
referral.desc: If you do not want to manage the complete sales and order process, you can refer potential customers to IDGen.
referral.note: The commercial benefits and responsibilities can be agreed according to the referral arrangement. Suitable for people or businesses with relevant connections who don't want inventory or production management.

erp.title: 3. School ERP Printing Partner
erp.tag: Your School Software. Our ID Card Production.
erp.desc: If you operate a School ERP, School management software, Student management platform, Attendance system, SIS, or EdTech solution, offer printed student and staff ID cards without building production infrastructure.
erp.note: Your company can continue focusing on software while IDGen supports the physical identification requirement.

tech.title: 4. Technology Integration Partner
tech.desc: Technology companies managing organizational data can explore future integration opportunities with IDGen to connect software data directly with card production.
tech.note: Reduces manual data transfer and makes production easier for organizations using compatible systems. Evaluated based on software, data structure, security and technical workflow.

offerings.title: What Can IDGen Partners Offer?

items.q: What is the IDGen reseller program?
items.a: The IDGen reseller program allows suitable businesses to acquire customers and offer IDGen identity products under an agreed reseller arrangement while IDGen supports the applicable production workflow.

items.q: Do I need my own ID card printing machine?
items.a: Not necessarily. The partner model is designed so suitable partners can focus on sales and customer relationships while IDGen supports production.

items.q: Can I become an IDGen reseller in my city?
items.a: Yes. IDGen is developing local partnerships across Northeast India and is interested in partners with local market knowledge and customer relationships.

items.q: Can a printing company become an IDGen partner?
items.a: Yes. Printing and related businesses can be considered where they have relevant customers and want to add identity products to their offering.

items.q: Can an IT company become an IDGen partner?
items.a: Yes. IT companies with relevant organizational or education-sector customers can explore reseller, referral or technology partnership models.

items.q: Can a School ERP company partner with IDGen?
items.a: Yes. A School ERP company can explore a printing partnership in which the ERP company serves the software requirement while IDGen supports physical student and staff ID-card production.

items.q: Can I become a referral partner?
items.a: Yes. Suitable businesses or individuals can explore a referral arrangement with IDGen.

items.q: Can partners sell multiple IDGen products?
items.a: Yes. The partner network can offer a range of identification products, including cards, RFID cards, event cards, membership cards, lanyards, holders and other identity products.

items.q: Does IDGen offer exclusive city territories?
items.a: Do not assume exclusivity. Territory arrangements, if available, should be discussed and agreed separately with IDGen.

items.q: Does IDGen provide fixed reseller margins?
items.a: Do not publish a universal margin unless IDGen has formally established one. Commercial terms can vary according to the partnership model and business arrangement.
